scope: User-authorized single-seed complete-epoch A/B/C development before six-layer progression.
authorization: The 2026-09-18 user instruction explicitly requests complete-window A/B tests, parameter iteration, optional C, and six-layer progression if these work. This replaces the earlier pending one-pass question. Use detached tmux for long runs and retain all outcomes.
training_rule: No request cap or timed training endpoint. Every epoch visits every request with an in-catalog positive once, including the last partial minibatch; sample one known positive uniformly per request each epoch. All-OOV fitting requests are explicitly counted and excluded from this known-item loss only. A/B/C continue real parent model and optimizer state. Default candidate is three full epochs for each phase; epoch1 retrieval is a learning-curve companion, not an automatic switch to the best future-label endpoint.
training_sufficiency: Retain complete-epoch mean loss and fixed training-only2048-request/target NLL before fitting and after every epoch. A fixed three-epoch budget is not proof of convergence; if it is still insufficient, record that fact and test a stated subsequent setting. Never rename a partial epoch as a completed model.
evaluation_rule: Frozen3072-request free-generation panel,1024 per day; separate frozen768-request sampled-diagnostic subset,256 per day. Uniform/popularity1000 share subset and candidate seed17. Preserve OOV misses, per-day results, request means and user means. A/B or B/C share identical future panels. Only development users are scored.
working_gate: Primary free-catalog beam300 FP32 NDCG@50. A must clearly beat matched random on D19-21; A and B must each beat random on D22-24 and B must improve over A there. Optional C repeats the same logic with B/C on D25-27. Report analytic random expectation and5000-trial random-policy variation. Keep the existing2x expectation and>null99 flags as declared working checks; companions do not replace the primary if it fails. Inspect all daily directions; do not select favorable days or cutoffs. Sampled diagnostics are not proof of free-generation quality.
parameter_iteration: This first preset changes to full windows/epochs and fixes one seed as requested. Keep lr1e-3, original loss and ID-only history. Later parameter tests change a stated training setting and retain the same evaluation panels, windows and random comparison. No final/admission outcomes are read.

resource_estimate.device: GPU2/3 only for both training and evaluation; disjoint from chronological A onGPU0/1.
resource_estimate.evaluation_basis: Three evaluations, each3072 free+768 sampled requests; approximately180s on two GPUs plus process startup. All use CPU Gloo waits.
resource_estimate.execution: Monitored directly with log/exit status; no changes to model/data/epoch/sampling/metric protocol.

progression: First inspect the complete small-backbone A/B result and, if useful, C stability. If the stable window checks pass, use the same protocol for the authorized six-layer model with a focused canary and measured resource estimate first. This is not formal phi admission, a Yambda result, or theta3 access.

execution_extension.purpose: Complete optional original-shuffle C while a separate chronological-order A uses GPU0/1. This retains the failed old-parent random result; C cannot alone qualify the original A/B chain.
